findings.title: High-impact actions lack prior human approval
findings.detail: Action-capable tools or agents can execute without an explicit Human Input approval gate.
findings.recommendation: Place a Human Input approval node immediately before high-impact actions and bind approval to the exact action payload.

findings.title: Retrieved content can influence an unapproved external action
findings.detail: A knowledge-retrieval node has a path to an action-capable tool or agent without a human approval boundary. Malicious retrieved content could steer downstream actions.
findings.recommendation: Treat retrieved content as untrusted, isolate instructions from data, validate tool arguments, and require approval before side effects.

findings.title: Webhook-triggered path can perform external actions
findings.detail: Internet-originated webhook data can reach a mutating HTTP request, tool, or agent action.
findings.recommendation: Require authenticated webhooks, replay protection, schema validation, rate limits, and idempotency keys.
